duplication_audit.novel_axis: all-threshold zero-dimensional persistence lifetimes of fixed delay-coordinate point clouds from four past-only scalar paths
duplication_audit.distinction: v29 RQA counts ordinal words and recurrence topology at one fixed distance threshold. v36 constructs a delay-coordinate point cloud, evaluates its full Vietoris-Rips connected-component filtration, and summarizes the zero-dimensional death times (equivalently MST edge lengths) across every merge scale. It is also distinct from fixed Fourier/wavelet, adaptive EMD, path-signature, and learned state-space representations.

rejected_axes.one_dimensional_persistence: not used because no pinned audited persistence library exists locally; v36 makes only the exact 0D/MST claim
rejected_axes.v35_ensemble_or_router: forbidden post-hoc reuse of the exposed EMD/Hilbert candidate

encoder.input: historical hs, tp, hmax, and wind-speed paths at fixed 20-minute subsampling from the past-only 48h context
encoder.case_normalization: median and IQR per path, deterministic zero-IQR fallback 1
encoder.filtration: Euclidean Vietoris-Rips H0; finite death times computed as deterministic minimum-spanning-tree edge lengths
encoder.zero_distance_tie_rule: off-diagonal exact-zero distances replaced by 1e-15 before MST

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Perea and Harer, Sliding Windows and Persistence: An Application of Topological Methods to Signal Analysis, Foundations of Computational Mathematics 15, 799-838 (2015)
primary_sources.use: motivation for sliding-window delay embeddings and persistent topology only; v36 uses deterministic H0 lifetimes and makes no source-derived performance claim
